versions.content: Processin of the read service detects an inconsistency. Diagnostic Event (Error Name) NVM_E_INTEGRITY_FAILED Description If the read for a block detects that the data and/or CRC are corrupted based on the CRC check performed after the read was finished successfully (JobEndNotification from underlyinh memory module). This only applies for blocks configured with CRC. Failed condition Fail condition: NVM_E_INTEGRITY_FAILED is reported by the NvM module if the processing of a read request will detect, via the CRC checking, corruption of the data and/or CRC of the block that was subject to the read operation. Passed condition Pass condition: when requirement SWS_NvM_00864 does not apply, meaning the data of the block is not corrupted in terms of CRC checking.
